title: Tip Release Schedule for Everyday Pay Card Cashouts — Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
On the Everyday Pay Card plans of Cartwise Shopper Payouts, how much of the unfinalized batch's tips a card cashout may carry depends on the shopper's level and tip history: a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Platinum level or above with no batch tip reduction in the last 6 months has those tips all released to the card; a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Silver level or above with exactly one batch tip reduction in the last 6 months has half of them released, rounded to the cent; any other shopper has none of them released.

## Definitions

- **The unfinalized batch's tips** — the total of the tip entries recorded by Cartwise Shopper Batches on the shopper's batch whose status is completed but which is not yet finalized.
- **Batch tip reduction** — a tip-reduction entry recorded by Cartwise Shopper Batches on any of the shopper's batches.
- **The last 6 months** — the entries booked fewer than 6 whole months before the day of the cashout.
- **Shopper level** — the level on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record. Levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond, and a level named with "or above" or "or below" is read in that order.

## Schedule

| Shopper level | Batch tip reductions in the last 6 months | Tips released to the card | Tips not released |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond | none (0) | all | none |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond | exactly 1 | half | half, rounded to the cent |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver or Gold | exactly 1 | half | half, rounded to the cent |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver or Gold | none (0) | none | all |
| Any level | 2 or more | none | all |
| Shop-Only Shopper or Full-Service Shopper | any number | none | all |

The table is read row by row from the clause: the all-released row needs both a level of Full-Service Shopper Platinum or above and zero reductions; the half row needs both a level of Full-Service Shopper Silver or above and exactly one reduction; every other combination has none of the tips released.

## Hypothetical illustrations

The inputs below are hypothetical. Suppose the unfinalized batch carries tips of 24.60.

- A Full-Service Shopper Diamond with no tip reduction in the last 6 months: all 24.60 released; nothing held back.
- A Full-Service Shopper Gold with exactly one tip reduction in the last 6 months: half released; 12.30 held back.
- A Full-Service Shopper Gold with no tip reduction in the last 6 months: none released; 24.60 held back.
- A Full-Service Shopper Platinum whose only tip reduction was booked 6 whole months or more before the day of the cashout: that reduction falls outside the last 6 months, so the count is zero and all 24.60 is released.
- A Full-Service Shopper with no tip reduction: none released; 24.60 held back.
